Use a plain very light neutral studio background and flat even reference lighting. No accessories, text, logos, handheld props, or environmental story.
acceptance_criteria: synthetic adult subject distinct from both other planned fixture identities
both hands and both feet visible
horizontal striped sweater and brick-red trousers clearly readable

striped sweater or brick-red trouser trap is not visually clear
